title: UMBRELLA: LTX 2.5 release (all dev-gated; the gate comes off together)
description: UMBRELLA created 2026-10-24 (Fabio). Everything that launches with LTX 2.5: the model's Stage 2 (MPI-1266), Keyframes to Video (MPI-1191), Storyboard (MPI-1231), stack reorder + Create Sheet, PiD 1.5 replacing the shipped PiD upscaler if it wins its bench (MPI-1185).
